context.body: The retelling joins the generation’s exclusion, two exceptions, Moses’ non-entry, and the children’s inheritance.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The LORD hears the words, swears that the evil generation will not see the good land, and names Caleb and Joshua as exceptions.
observations.label: The oath excludes the generation and places Moses beside it: action

observations.body: Moses says the LORD was angry with him for the people’s sake and that he too would not enter; the children will possess the land.
observations.label: The oath excludes the generation and places Moses beside it: response

observations.body: evil generation · Caleb · Joshua · angry with me · little ones · turn toward wilderness

payload.posture: Read Deuteronomy 1:34–40 as presumption and later retelling evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Numbers locates Moses’ explicit non-entry sentence later at Meribah, while Deuteronomy places it inside this Kadesh retelling.
payload.title: The oath excludes the generation and places Moses beside it
